value.signature: fn project_complete_registration (act : & ValidatedAct , verifier : & impl RegistrationVerifier ,) -> Result < CompleteRegistration , RegistrationError >

review.body: { let result = project (act , verifier) . and_then (| projection | { authorize_removals (& [act] , verifier) ? ; Ok (projection) }) ; if result . is_err () { tracing :: event ! (tracing :: Level :: TRACE , outcome = "refusal") ; } result }
review.item_premise: Registration operations consume immutable public records, diagnostic graph values and a declared deterministic public verifier. The verifier Debug and inputs contain public evidence only; no secret key or cryptographic implementation is admitted. Trace retains complete arguments and results, including refusals. Typed graph values are compared against reconstruction; serde bytes are diagnostic only and never canonical or binding equality. Observation supplies accounting only and never feeds computation. Registration and Affinity also reject protocol-reference fields their family blocks do not define, preserving the existing refusal accounting.
